name: progressive-cms
description: Progressive CMS — modular monolith CMS platform (see docs/specs/INDEX.md)

scripts.build:admin: node scripts/compose-first-party.mjs emit-admin "${PCMS_ADMIN_COMPOSITION:-standard}" apps/admin/src/extension/contributions.generated.ts && vite build --config apps/admin/vite.config.ts
scripts.scan: npm run scan:audit && npm run scan:licenses && npm run scan:admin-bundle
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run check:i18n && npm test && npm run build && npm run scan
scripts.prepare:extensions: node scripts/compose-first-party.mjs prepare-supply && node scripts/compose-first-party.mjs emit-admin standard apps/admin/src/extension/contributions.generated.ts
